fusions.name: Turned Furrow
fusions.desc: Drives the blade through the ground, cutting a furrow 4 tiles long that deals 7 earth damage to everything in it and leaves each enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Ox-Goad
fusions.desc: Prods with the full length of the haft for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 3.5 tiles, and drives the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Plough Team
fusions.desc: Puts every ally within 5 tiles in harness with you: they strike 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fight with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Long Furrow
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
